description: Chorus and ensemble effect built from one mono delay line sampled by eight taps panned alternately left and right, all moved by a single internal LFO

params.text: Sets the speed of the internal LFO that moves the eight taps
Sets how far the internal LFO moves the tap delay times
Scales the delay time of every tap together; short times thicken the sound and long times give the early reflections of a room
Sets the corner frequency of the two-pole high-pass filter at the output
Sets the corner frequency of the two-pole low-pass filter, which has a fixed resonance, that the signal passes through after saturation
Sets how hard the incoming signal is saturated before it reaches the delay line
Sets the balance between the dry input and the chorused signal

inputs.text: Modulates the modulation depth set by DEPTH
Modulates the LFO speed set by RATE
Modulates the tap delay times set by SPREAD
Modulates the low-pass corner frequency set by LP
Modulates the high-pass corner frequency set by HP
Modulates the input saturation set by DRIVE
Modulates the dry-to-wet balance set by MIX
The mono signal fed into the effect

outputs.text: The left channel of the stereo output
The right channel of the stereo output
